lines.text: Bob Dominator here
Hand on my heart,
running on the door
Sneakers by the mat
from the year before
Mama in the kitchen
numbing off keys
Saying kid don't chase
what you can't see
Late bus, late run, late on a dream
Writing on receipts, folded in my jeans
Friends on the corner top beat,
stay stuck I learned how to move
when the road got rough
Boom boom man I will run, will run, will run, will run
Keep running From the doubt, from the fear From the old me
now
Boom boom man I will run, will run, will run, will run
Won't stop, dot,
dot
Till my breath turns a prayer And my legs both numb
Back block, same cracks in the same sidewalks Uncle at the bar,
same school, same talk
Life's just this, with a sip, with a sigh I was scribbling
a map in the margins of my mind
I laughed for the plans I was making out
Who you think you are
When I played em out
But the nights that were cold made a flame
In my chest, every closed door
Just train me for the next Boom boom man
I will run, will run, will run, will run
Keep face past the blame, past the names
That they carved in the mud
I will run, will run, will run, will run
Every step, every scar turned this way into love
If I fall on my face, let me fall forward
If I lose my way, I still move onward
Feet sore, mind sore, but that won't stand still When the world
says quit, I just say I will
I will
Boom boom man
I will run, will run, will run, will run Run, run, with
the rain on my back and the weight on my lungs
I will run, will run, will run, will run
Till my name means hope, where I'm coming from
I will run, will run, will run, will run
Won't stop
Put the pain in my past, getting lighter each one
I will run, will run, will run, will run Cut sound in
my heartbeat,
draw
Boom boom man
I will run, will run, will run,
will run I will run, will run, will run, will run
Boom man I will run, will run, will run, will run
I will run
